description: This file contains a unit test for the Azure OpenAI chat model transformation in the litellm project. It imports necessary modules, sets up the environment, and defines an asynchronous test function that verifies the behavior of the 'async_transform_request' method of the 'AzureOpenAIO1Config' class.

classes.name: AzureOpenAIO1Config
classes.description: Configuration class for Azure OpenAI O-series models, specifically used here for testing transformations.
